description: A scale bar for the 2D map, in metric or imperial units. Exported PNGs and PDFs carry the same bar.

descriptionFull.title: Shows a scale bar, typically in a float-bottom-left panel over the map. The bar is labelled with a round distance (1, 2, 5, 10, ...) and follows the map as it zooms and pans, in metres and kilometres or feet and miles. While the bar is shown, PNG and PDF exports from the Share button draw a matching bar over the map's bottom-left corner; leave the tool out of the layout for no bar on the map or in exports. The bar hides while the map is tilted more than 10°, and exports of a tilted view carry no bar.

name: ScaleBar

components.name: Units
components.description: Metric labels the bar in metres and kilometres; imperial in feet and miles. Exports use the same units.
